sampling_unit: source JSON image record identified by unique image_id
selection: For each source independently, K=floor(fraction*N_source_image_records); sort by (SHA256 hex digest, canonical image_id, file_name) and keep K. Retain every annotation associated with each selected image_id. For GQA and Flickr30k, distinct image_id records may reference the same physical file_name; these official source records remain distinct.
objects365_class_coverage: Report categories absent after deterministic selection. Do not repair, resample, or add images after observing coverage. Missing coverage is recorded as WARN and the deterministic subset is retained unchanged.
grounding: GQA and Flickr30k preserve official source image_id-record semantics. image_id must remain unique. Duplicate file_name values are permitted. Every annotation associated with each selected image_id is retained. Pilot cache verification uses measured counts in PILOT_DATASET_LOCK.json.
missing_images: Strict pre-cache and pre-training check: selected count must equal existing selected image count; no silent image drop.
lock_file_policy: Generate PILOT_DATASET_LOCK.json only after real subset JSON, images, and caches are verified; never fabricate counts.
safety_rules: All generated outputs remain under pilot/v8s_10pct_v1
No cleanup unless explicitly requested within pilot data root

objects365.policy: retain deterministic 10% subset unchanged; no post-hoc coverage repair

grounding.reason: Official processed GQA/Flickr30k JSON contains multiple distinct image_id records referencing the same file_name.
grounding.policy: preserve source image_id records; permit duplicate file_name; do not merge or discard source records
